name: cash.balances
summary: Latest account snapshots or source daily closing balance observations.
purpose: Read native balances with explicit scope and frozen current-roster daily labels.

list.description: List latest snapshots, or daily observations when paired dates are supplied.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Exact native instId selection; default ALIPAYGM; ANY freezes the local entity selector.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Inclusive daily start YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD; requires to-date.

parameters.name: page-size
parameters.description: Latest only; native request width 1 through 100, default100.

identity_description: Adapter validates mode-specific native primary keys: latest balId; daily (entity,aliasName,currency,statisticalDate). No common native ID exists across modes.

fields.name: aliasName
fields.meaning: Native alias or explicitly attributed current-roster label.

fields.name: currency
fields.meaning: Native currency or frozen current-roster currency.

fields.name: entity
fields.meaning: Latest native entity; daily current-roster label, not historical ownership.

limitations: No dates selects latest snapshots. Paired dates select daily observations with fixed GMT+08 and closing book balance semantics.
Daily queries use disjoint at-most30-alias and at-most7-day chunks, at most1000 chunks; one900-second deadline includes roster acquisition.
Daily output retains every native field plus validated current roster entity/alias/currency labels; missing observations are not zero-filled.
Source counts, roster coverage, frozen selection and all chunk outcomes are retained independently. No unsupported Duckdog import or forecast computation.

examples.title: Source daily observations
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list cash.balances --live --entity ALIPAYGM --account-alias ACCOUNT --from-date 2026-10-01 --to-date 2026-10-07 --require-complete
